printer-keys.deviceTab.intro: Every key plays one M300 on this printer's buzzer. Play with the mouse, the keys A W S E D F T G Y H U J K (Z and X move the octave) or a MIDI keyboard.
printer-keys.deviceTab.lock.absent: This printer is not in the fleet.
printer-keys.deviceTab.lock.unsupported: This printer does not take G-code commands.
printer-keys.deviceTab.lock.busy: The printer is busy. The keys unlock when it is idle.
printer-keys.deviceTab.midi.insecure: MIDI needs Prusa Connect opened over HTTPS or on localhost
